work_ems.card.click_again_to_skip_tutori: Click again to skip the tutorial
work_ems.config.man_fell_off_ladder_in_h: A man fell off a ladder in his kitchen and knocked over a pot of boiling water. His arm is burned and his leg hurts badly. He is conscious. The caller is waiting next to him.
work_ems.config.place_breathing_tube_whi: Place the breathing tube while the oxygen level falls. On a patient put to sleep (Ketamine) and relaxed (Rocuronium), or in cardiac arrest.
work_ems.config.press_arrow_keys_when_ar: Press the arrow keys when the arrows reach the target. Used for bandages and dressings.
work_ems.config.press_space_in_steady_rh: Press SPACE in a steady rhythm (100-120 per minute). Used when the heart has stopped. On a patient, good compressions can change the heart rhythm: the game stops and the panel shows the new rhythm.
work_ems.config.press_space_when_gauge_n: Press SPACE when the gauge needle is centred to cinch each wrap. Used for fractures.
work_ems.config.push_needle_into_vein_th: Push the needle into the vein, then pull it back. Needed for fluids and medicines.
work_ems.main.press_j_to_open_ems_tablet: Press J to open the EMS tablet and sign in as a unit.
work_ems.main.you_cannot_go_on_duty_righ: You cannot go on duty right now.
work_ems.session.hospital_markers_could_: The hospital markers could not be created (med_hospitals).
work_ems.session.medical_system_is_not_r: The medical system is not running.
The medical system is not running - the patient steps are skipped.
work_ems.session.minigame_could_not_be_s: The minigame could not be started.
work_ems.session.no_problem_you_can_star: No problem. You can start the tutorial any time with /{command}.
work_ems.session.patient_died_new_patien: The patient died - a new patient is waiting.
work_ems.session.this_minigame_is_not_av: This minigame is not available right now.
work_ems.session.tutorial_ambulance_was_: The tutorial ambulance was destroyed. Start again with /{command}.
work_ems.session.tutorial_completed_good: Tutorial completed. Good luck on duty!
work_ems.session.tutorial_could_not_be_s: The tutorial could not be started.
work_ems.session.tutorial_ended_because_: The tutorial ended because you died.
work_ems.session.tutorial_skipped_you_ca: Tutorial skipped. You can start it again any time with /{command}.
work_ems.session.you_cannot_start_tutori: You cannot start the tutorial now.
work_ems.steps.active_case_page_priority:
The Active Case page: the priority (P1 is the most urgent, P4 the least), the title, the location and distance, the caller and the description. On a real case a yellow route on the GPS leads you to the scene.

Start Response means lights & siren and status En Route. It switches on by itself when you drive off (to the scene or away from it), but you can also press it - do it now.
work_ems.steps.blood_pressure_oxygen_lev:
Blood pressure, oxygen level (SpO2) and the heart rhythm (ECG) need the monitor.

Click Attach monitor / defibrillator in the heart rate tile.
work_ems.steps.burn_is_dressed_now_fract:
The burn is dressed. Now the fracture: press Splint.

A needle swings across a gauge: press SPACE while it is inside the centre window to tighten each wrap. A miss is not a failure, wait for the next pass.
work_ems.steps.caller_says_patient_is_wa: The caller says the patient is waiting right next to your ambulance.
work_ems.steps.case_was_assigned_to_you_:
A case was assigned to you - that was the alert sound.

Open it: click the case card on the Home page, or open the menu (top right) and choose Active Case.
work_ems.steps.cases_come_from_dispatche: ·  Cases come from the dispatchers or the automatic dispatcher. Press Start Response and follow the route.
work_ems.steps.contents_of_medical_bag_w:
The contents of the medical bag (the inventory window): the medicines, IV kits, bandages, splints, the oxygen cylinder, the glucometer and the airway kit.

They run out as you use them: one IV kit per attempt (a failed one too), one dose per medicine, one bandage per dressing, one splint per fracture, and the oxygen drains while a mask or a tube is on. You restock the bag in a hospital's ambulance bay - you will do it at the end of the tutorial. Press ESC to close the window.
work_ems.steps.defibrillator_charge_200_:
The defibrillator. CHARGE (200 J), then SHOCK when it flashes. Only two rhythms need a shock: VF and pulseless VT. ANALYZE checks an unresponsive patient for you and charges if a shock is needed. SYNC is for VT with a pulse, SOUND mutes the beep and the alarm.

Never shock a patient with a normal rhythm - it stops the heart. Do not shock this patient.
work_ems.steps.equipment_that_went_in_on: {text} The equipment that went in on the stretcher comes out with it: the oxygen and the monitor stay connected.
work_ems.steps.every_treatment_of_panel_: Every treatment of the panel is a minigame. Here they run without a patient: play any of them as many times as you like. CPR and intubation are worth a try - you did not need them today.
work_ems.steps.everything_is_back_in_amb:
Everything is back in the ambulance. You used a bandage, a splint, an IV kit, a dose of Fentanyl and oxygen.

Go to the side door, press X and choose Restock bag. It works only while the ambulance stands in a hospital's ambulance bay; stand still for a few seconds. Restocking is free.
work_ems.steps.examine_patient_x_1_attac: ·  Examine the patient (X, 1), attach the monitor, and treat what the panel shows: bandage, splint, IV access, medicines, oxygen. Shock only VF and pulseless VT.
work_ems.steps.fracture_still_hurts_lot_:
The fracture still hurts a lot - the pain needs a medicine through a vein. First: press IV access.

Push the needle into the vein, then pull it back. Every attempt uses one IV kit from the bag.
work_ems.steps.go_on_duty_take_ambulance: ·  Go on duty, take an ambulance at the vehicle point and sign in on the tablet ({tablet_key}).
work_ems.steps.here_you_read_and_send_me: Here you read and send messages. Switch between the two channels at the top, and write with the button at the bottom. Try it if you like.
work_ems.steps.injuries_their_severity_a: The injuries: their severity and whether they are treated. This patient has a minor burn and a fracture. You will treat both in the next step.
work_ems.steps.is_this_your_first_shift_:
Is this your first shift? The tutorial shows you the EMS tablet, your equipment, the examination panel and the monitor / defibrillator, the treatments, the stretcher, the hospital handover and restocking. It takes about 15 minutes in a private copy of the world.

It is not required: you can skip it now and start it any time later with /{command}.
work_ems.steps.iv_access_airway_and_pain: IV access, airway and pain. Most medicines need an IV access; the ones marked oral do not.
work_ems.steps.last_press_o2_mask_o2_chi:
Last: press O2 mask.

The O2 chip in the header drops while the mask is on - also in the ambulance. If the bag is farther than 6 m from the patient or the cylinder runs empty, the mask comes off (an intubated patient keeps the tube, but it does nothing without oxygen).
work_ems.steps.lifepak_15_monitor_top_he:
The Lifepak 15 monitor. Top: the heart rate with the ECG and the name of the rhythm under it - you do not have to read the ECG. Bottom: SpO2 with its wave and the blood pressure (NIBP: the upper value big, the lower one under it, the mean in brackets).

The monitor beeps on every heart beat. It stays connected up to 6 m: do not walk away with it.
work_ems.steps.load_empty_stretcher_and_: ·  Load the empty stretcher and restock the bag in the bay.
work_ems.steps.load_patient_with_stretch: ·  Load the patient with the stretcher, park in a hospital's ambulance bay and push the stretcher into the handover marker.
work_ems.steps.look_at_patient_and_press: Look at the patient and press X to open the world menu (Q / E switch between nearby menus), then press 1: Examine patient.
work_ems.steps.now_press_medication_and_:
Now press Medication and choose Fentanyl (a strong painkiller).

The number on each medicine card is the doses left in the bag (x3 = three). A medicine at 0 cannot be given until you restock.
work_ems.steps.now_take_equipment_in_sam: Now take the equipment: in the same menu choose Take both. The medical bag goes into your left hand, the monitor / defibrillator into your right.
work_ems.steps.open_examination_panel_ag: Open the examination panel again: look at the patient, press X, then 1.
work_ems.steps.oxygen_mask_was_not_chang: The oxygen mask was not changed
work_ems.steps.panel_is_open_again_try_o: {key}. The panel is open again - try once more.
work_ems.steps.panel_on_right_shows_what:
The panel on the right shows what you hold and the bag's IV kits and oxygen; I opens the inventory window, H puts the items down. While carrying you cannot jump or get into any vehicle: put the equipment back at the side door first.

Carry them to the patient: they work within 4 m. Never leave them at a scene - when the ambulance drives away without them, the crew is warned.

At the patient press X, then 1: Examine patient.
work_ems.steps.patient_is_handed_over_eq:
The patient is handed over. The equipment stays on the stretcher (in a bay the ambulance shows EQUIPMENT MISSING while something is out).

Push the empty stretcher back to the rear doors and choose Load into ambulance: the equipment on it goes back in.
work_ems.steps.patient_is_in_ambulance_b: The patient is in the ambulance, but {items_outside} is still outside. Bring it back: go to the side door, press X and put it back (or simply get into the ambulance while holding it).
work_ems.steps.patient_is_in_ambulance_d: The patient is in the ambulance. Driving to the hospital...
work_ems.steps.patient_is_on_stretcher_c: The patient is on the stretcher. Choose Push stretcher, walk back to the rear doors of the ambulance and choose Load into ambulance.
work_ems.steps.patient_is_on_stretcher_n:
The patient is on the stretcher. Now the equipment: it rides on the side of the stretcher, so the oxygen and the monitor travel with the patient.

In the stretcher menu choose Put medical bag on stretcher and Put monitor on stretcher (the items must lie within 2 m of it). Then Push stretcher to the rear doors and choose Load into ambulance.
work_ems.steps.press_to_open_tablet_agai: Press {tablet_key} to open the tablet again.
work_ems.steps.push_stretcher_into_blue_: Push the stretcher into the blue Patient Handover marker and stay in it for 5 seconds.
work_ems.steps.rest_is_automatic_your_st:
The rest is automatic: your status becomes On Scene when you arrive, and Handover when you park in a hospital's ambulance bay with the patient.

Leave Case releases your unit while another unit stays on the case. Close Case ends a false call (a reason is needed). End Shift is in the menu.
work_ems.steps.stretcher_is_in_but_is_st: The stretcher is in, but {items_outside} is still outside. Put it back at the side door (X, Put ... back).
work_ems.steps.stretcher_is_out_bring_it:
The stretcher is out. Bring it next to the patient if needed (Push stretcher, then Release stretcher to put it down).

Then choose Place patient on stretcher in its menu and click the patient.
work_ems.steps.take_bag_and_monitor_at_s: ·  Take the bag and the monitor at the side door. Keep them within 4 m of the patient, and never leave them at the scene.
work_ems.steps.these_chips_show_equipmen:
These chips show the equipment within reach (4 m) of the patient: the MONITOR, the BAG and the oxygen left in it. Green = here, grey = missing.

Without equipment you can still examine, do a Neuro exam, CPR and request transport - every other button is grey, hover it to see why.
work_ems.steps.this_is_examination_panel: This is the examination panel. The top bar is the consciousness: Stable, Dazed, Unconscious, Clinical death or Dead. In clinical death a countdown runs next to it.
work_ems.steps.this_is_sign_in_screen_pi:
This is the sign-in screen. Pick a unit type: SOLO (single responder), DOC (physician), BLS / ALS (basic / advanced life support ambulance) or HELI (air ambulance). An ambulance crew is usually BLS or ALS.

You can also set a unit number and add the crew mates sitting near you. Then press Sign In.
work_ems.steps.treat_injuries_start_with:
Treat the injuries. Start with the burn: press Bandage.

Press the matching arrow key when an arrow reaches the target.
work_ems.steps.treatments_in_rows_grey_b:
The treatments, in rows. A grey button cannot be used now - hover it to see why.

AB (airway, breathing): Intubate - after Ketamine, then Rocuronium (or in cardiac arrest)  ·  O2 mask.
CD (circulation): Bandage - wounds, burns  ·  Splint - fractures  ·  CPR - stopped heart  ·  IV access  ·  Medication - a list of medicines, point at one to read what it does.
Transport: a vehicle for a stable, intubated or dead patient (off in the tutorial).
work_ems.steps.well_done_burn_is_dressed:
Well done: the burn is dressed, the leg splinted, the pain treated and the patient gets oxygen.

Close the panel (the X in its corner, or Backspace) whenever you like. The patient goes to the hospital next.
work_ems.steps.without_monitor_you_only_:
Without the monitor you only see what you can feel and see: the pulse (heart rate), the bleeding and the skin (pale = blood loss, blue = too little oxygen).

Green is normal; yellow, orange and red are worse. The values change live.
work_ems.steps.you_are_signed_in_header_:
You are signed in. The header shows your callsign, unit type, plate and status (green = Available).

The Home page shows your shift and your active case. Cases are assigned to free units by the dispatchers, or automatically by the system.
work_ems.steps.you_are_sitting_in_your_a:
You are sitting in your ambulance. Every EMS unit works with the EMS tablet: you sign in on it, get your cases and talk to the dispatchers.

Press {tablet_key} to open the tablet.
work_ems.steps.you_arrived_at_hospital_o:
You arrived at the hospital. On a real case, parking in a yellow ambulance bay with the patient starts the Handover status.

Get out, go to the rear doors and take out the stretcher - the patient comes out on it.
work_ems.steps.you_arrived_at_scene_so_y:
You arrived at the scene, so your status is On Scene.

Close the tablet with {tablet_key}.
work_ems.steps.you_got_message_messages_:
You got a message. Messages has two channels: Dispatch (your unit and the dispatchers) and Case (every unit on the case and the dispatchers).

Open the menu and choose Messages.
work_ems.steps.your_patient_is_standing_:
Your patient is standing next to the ambulance. Before you go to them, take your equipment: with bare hands you can only examine.

Get out (F) and go to the side door on the right side of the ambulance. Press X there to open the Ambulance equipment menu and choose Check contents.
work_ems.steps.your_patient_is_treated_a:
Your patient is treated and goes to the hospital. Your equipment lies next to them - a treatment put it down there.

Go to the rear doors of the ambulance, press X and choose Take out stretcher.
